verdict.summary: Round 5 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The cache proof binds reuse to the pinned tarball digest and a deterministic path-and-content digest, while the hermetic self-test exercises the real script through valid reuse and rejection of a count-preserving edit, missing proof, and wrong pin. The benchmark runner keeps its comparator claim explicitly bounded: unsupported or malformed GML falls back to verbatim comparison, entity references and escaping are preserved, and focused non-vacuous tests distinguish semantic changes from the formatting differences intentionally folded. The research record accurately limits comparator uncertainty to the GML-bearing requirements and avoids overclaiming the resulting rank. Relative to round 4, the approved state and empty finding set are materially unchanged.
